description.velox-server-connect.server_:
The name of the server

$m - Uses the Modpack Name value
The IP address of the server you want to connect to
The port of the server you want to connect to
description.velox-server-connect.button_:
The text displayed on the title screen button

$m - Uses the Modpack Name value
$s - Uses the Server Name value
description.velox-server-connect.modpack: The name of the modpack. Can be used in the Server Name or Button Text with the $m marker
description.velox-server-connect.y_offse:
The Y offset of the button on the title screen. Can be used to position the button differently depending on how many buttons are on the main menu:

0 - Singleplayer, Multiplayer, Realms, and Mods
1 - Singleplayer, Multiplayer, and Realms OR Mods
2 - Singleplayer and Multiplayer only
description.velox-server-connect.show_se: Toggles the server name on the connect button tooltip
description.velox-server-connect.show_on: Toggles the server's online status on the connect button tooltip
description.velox-server-connect.show_pi: Toggles the server's ping on the connect button tooltip
description.velox-server-connect.show_pl: Toggles the server's player count on the connect button tooltip
description.velox-server-connect.hide_re: Toggles the Minecraft Realms button on the title screen
